components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strong action that advances setup or replay.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font-body, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); background: var(--text, #1f2933); color: var(--bg-primary, #f7f4ee); border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 16px 48px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 18px 40px rgba(31, 41, 51, 0.14)); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: revert; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Back Button
components.description: A quiet pill for backing out of the current task.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: var(--font-body, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); background: transparent; color: var(--text, #1f2933); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e0d8cc); border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(47, 124, 109, 0.4); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm, 0 12px 24px rgba(31, 41, 51, 0.08)); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: revert; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Mode Card
components.description: A large, descriptive mode choice for the start screen.
components.css: .ds-mode-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; min-height: 180px; padding: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e0d8cc); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--bg-card, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)); color: var(--text, #1f2933); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm, 0 12px 24px rgba(31, 41, 51, 0.08)); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-mode-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 18px 40px rgba(31, 41, 51, 0.14)); border-color: rgba(47, 124, 109, 0.35); } .ds-mode-card:active { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-mode-card:focus-visible { outline: revert; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-mode-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-mode-icon { font-size: 40px; } .ds-mode-title { font: 600 22px/1.5 var(--font-body, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-mode-copy { color: var(--muted, #5b6775); font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-body, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); }

components.name: Setup Panel
components.description: A softly contained group for one setup decision.
components.html:
Choose Your Color

White goes first. Black goes second.
components.css: .ds-setup-panel { width: min(560px, 100%); padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e0d8cc); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--bg-card, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)); color: var(--text, #1f2933); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm, 0 12px 24px rgba(31, 41, 51, 0.08)); text-align: center; } .ds-setup-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 600 20px/1.5 var(--font-body, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-setup-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #5b6775); font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-body, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); }

components.name: Difficulty Scale
components.description: Ten circular choices that progress from forgiving green to challenging red.
components.css: .ds-difficulty { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-difficulty button { width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0; border: 2px solid var(--ds-level); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg-card, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)); color: var(--ds-level); font: 600 16px/1 var(--font-body, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-difficulty button:hover, .ds-difficulty .ds-selected { background: var(--ds-level); color: #fff; transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-difficulty .ds-selected { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); } .ds-difficulty button:active { transform: scale(1); } .ds-difficulty button:focus-visible { outline: revert; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: The sticky brand bar with compact pill navigation and appearance control.
components.html: ♞Kids Chess
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding: 20px 48px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e0d8cc); background: var(--bg-header, rgba(247, 244, 238, 0.8)); color: var(--text, #1f2933); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font: 600 20px/1.5 var(--font-display, ui-serif, 'Times New Roman', serif); } .ds-brand-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--brand-bg, #1f2933); color: var(--brand-text, #f7f2e9); font-size: 18px; } .ds-nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-nav button { border: 1px solid var(--line, #e0d8cc); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #1f2933); padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 14px/1.5 var(--font-body, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav button:hover { border-color: rgba(47, 124, 109, 0.4); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm, 0 12px 24px rgba(31, 41, 51, 0.08)); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { background: var(--bg-card, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)); border-color: rgba(31, 41, 51, 0.5); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm, 0 12px 24px rgba(31, 41, 51, 0.08)); } .ds-nav .ds-theme { width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: revert; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Game Controls
components.description: The paired recoverable and reset actions beneath the board.
components.css: .ds-game-controls { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-game-controls button { padding: 14px 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; color: #f7f2e9; font: 600 18px/1.5 var(--font-body, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-game-controls button:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-game-controls button:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-game-controls button:focus-visible { outline: revert; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-undo { background: #d28a54; } .ds-undo:hover { background: #c47b45; } .ds-new-game { background: #1f2933; } .ds-new-game:hover { background: #11181f; }

components.name: Game Over Dialog
components.description: The focused outcome surface where playfulness and celebration are allowed to peak.
components.html:
🏆

You Win!

Amazing! You beat the computer!
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(400px, 100%); padding: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e0d8cc); border-radius: 28px; background: var(--bg-card, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)); color: var(--text, #1f2933); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 18px 40px rgba(31, 41, 51, 0.14)); text-align: center; } .ds-dialog-emoji { margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: 72px; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #2f7c6d; font: 700 32px/1.5 var(--font-display, ui-serif, 'Times New Roman', serif); } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0 0 32px; color: var(--muted, #5b6775); font: 400 18px/1.5 var(--font-body, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-dialog button { width: 100%; padding: 14px 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--brand-bg, #1f2933); color: var(--brand-text, #f7f2e9); font: 600 18px/1.5 var(--font-body, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-dialog button:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-dialog button:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible { outline: revert; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The Friendly Chess Club treats a family tablet like a welcoming game table: warm parchment, slate ink, and restrained felt green create a calm place to play. A traditional serif voice gives chess its sense of occasion, while direct system sans-serif text keeps every choice legible and immediate for young children.

Interfaces are spacious, centered, and softly contained. Large touch targets feel tactile and forgiving without becoming toy-like. The system stays warm, calm, capable, and playful in moments—never babyish. Magic is deliberately concentrated in wins and encouragement so gameplay itself remains focused.
keyCharacteristics: Warm parchment and slate neutrals anchored by restrained felt green.
Traditional serif display type paired with highly legible system sans-serif controls.
Rounded, tactile controls and softly layered containers sized for young hands.
Calm gameplay surfaces with celebratory emoji and motion reserved for rewards.
Parallel light and dark themes that preserve semantic roles.

rules.name: The Calm Field Rule
rules.body: Felt Green is an accent, not a wash; the board and surrounding canvas stay quiet enough for chess state to lead.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Amber means recoverable action and red means chess danger; never reuse either as casual decoration.

rules.name: The Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Dark mode changes luminance, not hierarchy, meaning, or component behavior.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif type names important moments; sans-serif type operates the product. Do not introduce a third voice.

rules.name: The One-Task Center Rule
rules.body: Give the active choice or chessboard the visual center; surrounding navigation stays secondary.

rules.name: The Tablet-First Rule
rules.body: Size and space interactions for young hands, and never require precise dragging to complete a core action.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest on borders and low shadow; high shadow and upward movement appear only when hierarchy or interaction earns them.

rules.name: The Rounded Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Radius grows with containment and importance; do not mix sharp rectangles into the established 12–28px family.

rules.name: The Rewarded Whimsy Rule
rules.body: Keep routine gameplay calm; reserve animated emoji, rainbow effects, and larger gestures for wins and encouragement.

dos: Do use large, unmistakable targets and preserve tap-tap interaction.
Do let Parchment, Slate Ink, and Paper Card carry most of every screen.
Do reserve Felt Green for meaningful interaction and positive emphasis.
Do preserve the same semantic color roles in light and dark themes.
Do use low shadow at rest and high shadow only for priority or response.
Do keep routine transitions between 150ms and 300ms, with longer motion reserved for dialogs and celebrations.
donts: Don't turn the product into a neon arcade, preschool toy, or corporate dashboard.
Don't flood screens with primary colors or distribute whimsical decoration across routine gameplay.
Don't repurpose Takeback Amber or Check Red as decorative accents.
Don't add sharp-cornered cards or a third type family.
Don't use heavy shadows or large movement on every control.
Don't rely on animation, sound, or color alone to communicate game state.
